name: aimz
description: AIMZ bookkeeping, invoicing and inventory for wholesalers, inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
AIMZ is bookkeeping, inventory and invoicing for wholesale and distribution businesses. Connect your AIMZ business and run it by asking in plain words: create and edit invoices with each customer's own prices, record payments (spread oldest-first, with leftovers kept as customer credit), adjust and move stock, receive purchases from suppliers, record supplier bills and expenses, handle customer returns, email invoices and statements, and ask who owes you money or how sales are going.

Every change is shown as a preview first and saved only after you confirm. The assistant works with exactly your own AIMZ access level, on one business per connection, and every action is marked in your AIMZ activity log. Deleting or voiding records, staff and settings stay in the AIMZ app.

positive.prompt: What business am I connected to and what can I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the business name, currency, the user's role and allowed areas, plan usage and last-30-day totals.

positive.description: Create an invoice with a preview and confirmation
positive.prompt: Invoice Demo Grocery for 5 boxes of Demo Orange Juice
positive.expected_behavior: preview_change shows the would-be invoice as an invoice card stamped PREVIEW · NOT SAVED (customer's tier price, total and due date) and saves nothing; after the user confirms, create_invoice saves it once and returns the invoice number, total and balance.

Shows invoice #3 for Fresh Foods Market as an invoice card in the AIMZ app's layout: items, totals, amount paid $10.00 and balance due $11.60, with a Download PDF button that opens the same invoice as a PDF.

positive.prompt: Show the balance sheet for Fresh Foods Market
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the customer's Advanced Balance Sheet card: total outstanding, total payments, each invoice with its paid / partial / due status, and the recorded payments, matching what the customer owes.

positive.prompt: Demo Grocery paid 100 by bank transfer
positive.expected_behavior: Preview shows the amount applied to open invoices oldest first and any remainder kept as credit; confirming records it and returns the split.

positive.prompt: We counted 40 boxes of Demo Orange Juice, set the stock to 40
positive.expected_behavior: Preview shows the current quantity changing to 40 with the reason; confirming updates stock and returns the new quantity.
Lists active customers with an outstanding balance, largest first, with the total owed.

negative.prompt: Delete all my invoices from last month
Book me a flight to Dubai

review.commerce_description: AIMZ does not sell anything or process payments; it records bookkeeping entries (invoices, payments received, supplier bills) in the user's own AIMZ business.
